name: Blue Blaster
source:
Protagonist Mytyl is working as a mechanic for the United Earth Army. While making adjustments on a new prototype named Blue Blaster, enemies attack and he is involved in actual combat.

Mytyl somehow manages to pilot the ship but what waits for him afterwards is getting forcefully enrolled into the the 190th Special Force, which is only made of female members...

[Translated from Getchu]
translation:
主人公米蒂尔是地球联合军的一名整备师。某天正当他对新型原型机“Blue Blaster”进行调试时，敌军突然来袭，将他卷入了实战之中。

米蒂尔阴差阳错地驾驶该机化险为夷，可事后等待着他的，却是被强行编入全员皆为女性的第190特殊部队……

[译自Getchu]
